hook: 3.66 million ladders recalled after only 25 sudden‑retraction reports nationwide.

sections.voiceover: 3.66 million ladders recalled after only 25 sudden‑retraction reports nationwide.
On November 5 2026 the CPSC recalled 3.66 million Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks. How'd 25 reports of Little Giant Rapid Lock ladders suddenly retracting cause 19 consumer injuries?
But the hazard doesn't stop there; it covers 11 Little Giant models sold through October 2026.
The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission logged 3 head injuries tied to Little Giant retractions. Those 3 severe head injuries from Rapid Locks included traumatic brain injury and vision loss.
A total of 3.66 million ladders are now off the market.
